chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Talhah ibn Zayd from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) would inherit the hermaphrodite from the place where they urinate.

key_terms.مِنْ حَيْثُ يَبُولُ: From the place where he/she urinates

ai.seo_question: How is a hermaphrodite's inheritance share determined in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* outlines the juristic principle of *istishab* (presumption of continuity) applied to the *khuntha* (hermaphrodite), where inheritance shares are assigned based on the dominant urinary organ until gender is definitively established. Attributed to Imam Ali (AS), this ruling reflects the early Shia legal methodology of utilizing observable physical signs to resolve ambiguity in inheritance distribution, a topic extensively debated by later scholars like Al-Mufid and Al-Tusi regarding the distinction between *khuntha mushkil* and *khuntha mubinn*.
